notes: The Firm: notSTOCK (NOTSTOCK) with its LP desk on Base (chain 8453), paired with IMD, built to SPEC.md at commit 2d14646. Token: LaunchToken, fixed supply 1,000,000,000 at 18 decimals, no owner, mint, fee, pause or upgrade; the factory splits it (30% pool, 10% swarm, 60% to the project wallet, which then transfers exactly 600,000,000 NOTSTOCK to GenesisSplitter). Three application contracts, in constructor dependency order, nothing called at deploy. LpDesk(token, operator, projectWallet): token is the launch token; operator is the dev wallet 0x8ad18e99f4c8d8406f9ba8899cf308000518a981 fixed by SPEC.md section 1 (it may hand the role on; no power beyond SPEC section 2); projectWallet is the project wallet 0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c fixed by SPEC.md section 1, written as that literal address, the only wallet any held asset can go to. Its constructor creates Burner with new; LpDesk records msg.sender (the factory) as the launch factory for PriceGuard.registerNotStock. The modules LpGovernor, PriceGuard, VenueV3, VenueV4 and DeskSwap are not launch contracts: anyone deploys each once after launch through LpDesk.deployModule(kind, creationCode) (CREATE2, code hash fixed in LpDesk; script/DeployModules.s.sol). FirmVault(projectWallet, lpDesk): projectWallet is the same fixed project wallet 0x3c587eff6c96eacf7e3dcc2cff6416161386e48c, lpDesk is $contract:LpDesk; it is the pool fee recipient once the project wallet calls the factory's setRequester(launchNumber, FirmVault); distribute(token) splits IMD 25/25/25/25 (buyback bucket, project wallet, LpDesk IMD top-up basket, LpDesk free IMD) and NOTSTOCK 100% to Burner; buyback(amount, minOut) is operator-only and burns all output. GenesisSplitter(lpDesk, devWallet): lpDesk is $contract:LpDesk, devWallet is the dev wallet; split() once sends 50/60 of its NOTSTOCK to LpDesk and 10/60 to the dev wallet. No owner, pause, upgrade or minting anywhere; no linked libraries or delegatecall. Pool: NOTSTOCK/IMD, pairedCurrency IMD 0xff0c532fdb8cd566ae169c1cb157ff2bdc83e105, fee 12500 (1.25%), tick spacing 60; the deployer opens it from the policy's 2,500 IMD opening cap, so initialPrice is the launch's given value and not the opening price. The factory supplies the MerkleDistributor and the initialization-only pool guard. Deviations required by the launch rules are listed in ADAPTATION.md.
